profileSummary.textContent: Your starting point: comfortable alignment and firm comfort.

profileReflection.textContent: You are shopping for a King, sleep solo, sleep mostly on your back, and prefer a firm feel.

profileReassurance.textContent: This brief guides where we start. Your comfort during the test decides what stays.

profilePrioritiesIntro.textContent: Use these signals to compare each mattress instead of relying on first impressions alone.

profilePriorities.innerHTML:
• Comfortable alignment
    Your normal sleep position needs steady support without creating new pressure.
    Must solve
    Try this: Lie in your usual position and notice whether your waist and lower back feel naturally supported.
  • Firm, not rigid
    You prefer a solid surface, but firmness should not create pressure.
    Feel preference
    Try this: Notice whether you feel supported everywhere or pushed at the shoulder, hip, or lower back.

profileJourneySteps.innerHTML:
Compare your matches
Record what feels best
Build around the finalist

profileJourneyCopy.textContent: Then we will explore Adjustability, Support, Pillow, and Protection. Every choice is optional.

gold.name: Royal Reserve Extra Firm
gold.highlight: Hand-made extra-firm — maximum support, luxury materials
gold.highlight_es: Extra firme hecho a mano — máximo soporte, materiales de lujo

topPickReason.en: Hand-made extra-firm support — the choice for back and stomach sleepers who want luxury.
topPickReason.es: Soporte extra firme hecho a mano — la elección para quienes duermen boca arriba o boca abajo y quieren lujo.

detail.en: Holds you fully on top of the bed — the firmest luxury option in the store.
detail.es: Te mantiene completamente sobre la cama — la opción de lujo más firme de la tienda.

detail.en: Natural materials and hand assembly keep the firm feel from softening early.
detail.es: Los materiales naturales y el ensamblaje a mano evitan que la firmeza se ablande antes de tiempo.

gold.name: The Roma
gold.highlight: Handcrafted firm luxury in Merino wool and cashmere
gold.highlight_es: Lujo firme artesanal en lana Merino y cachemira

topPickReason.en: Handcrafted natural-fiber luxury with firm, breathable coil-on-coil support.
topPickReason.es: Lujo artesanal de fibras naturales con soporte firme de doble resorte que respira.

title.es: Capas de confort de fibras naturales

detail.en: Merino wool, camel hair, and cashmere breathe and temper heat in a way synthetic foams can't.
detail.es: La lana Merino, el pelo de camello y la cachemira respiran y regulan el calor como las espumas sintéticas no pueden.

title.es: Doble resorte con látex de grafito

detail.en: Responsive lift and stability instead of the slow sink of memory foam.
detail.es: Elevación receptiva y estabilidad en lugar del hundimiento lento de la espuma viscoelástica.

gold.name: The Palermo
gold.highlight_es: 4,294 resortes de soporte firme copetudo a mano

topPickReason.en: Massive 4,294-coil count with hand-tufted craftsmanship for firm, lasting alignment.
topPickReason.es: Enorme cantidad de 4,294 resortes con artesanía copetuda a mano para una alineación firme y duradera.

detail.en: Several times the coil count of a standard bed — finer, more contoured firm support.
detail.es: Varias veces los resortes de una cama estándar — soporte firme más fino y contorneado.

detail.en: Tufting locks the layers so the pillowtop can't shift or pocket over years of use.
detail.es: El copetudo fija las capas para que el pillowtop no se mueva ni se deforme con los años.

silver.name: Platinum Paige Extra Firm
silver.highlight: Maximum support with luxury Paige comfort layers
silver.highlight_es: Máximo soporte con capas de confort de lujo Paige

topPickReason.en: The firmest Platinum — extra-firm zoned support in a luxury build.
topPickReason.es: El Platinum más firme — soporte extra firme zonificado en construcción de lujo.

detail.en: Noticeably firmer than the Paige Firm — for sleepers who want no sink at all.
detail.es: Notablemente más firme que el Paige Firme — para quienes no quieren hundirse nada.

detail.en: Marvelous Middle reinforcement keeps hips level in every position.
detail.es: El refuerzo Marvelous Middle mantiene las caderas niveladas en cualquier posición.

silver.name: Kendall Extra Firm
silver.highlight: Extra-firm zoned support at a working price
silver.highlight_es: Soporte extra firme zonificado a un precio accesible

topPickReason.en: Serious extra-firm zoned support at the best price in its class.
topPickReason.es: Soporte extra firme zonificado serio al mejor precio de su clase.

detail.en: A flat, supportive surface with no plush give — for sleepers who want solid.
detail.es: Una superficie plana y de soporte sin suavidad — para quienes quieren algo sólido.

detail.en: Thicker center coils protect the firm feel from early body impressions.
detail.es: Resortes centrales más gruesos protegen la firmeza de las marcas corporales tempranas.

silver.name: Platinum Paige Firm
silver.highlight: Luxury 16-inch box top with firm zoned support
silver.highlight_es: Box top de lujo de 16 pulgadas con soporte firme zonificado

topPickReason.en: Luxury box-top comfort with firm, zoned center-third support.
topPickReason.es: Confort box-top de lujo con soporte firme zonificado en el centro.

detail.en: 25% more support under hips and lower back, where most beds sag first.
detail.es: 25% más soporte bajo caderas y espalda baja, donde la mayoría de las camas se hunden primero.

detail.en: A tailored 16-inch profile with plush surface layers over a firm core.
detail.es: Un perfil de 16 pulgadas con capas superficiales suaves sobre un núcleo firme.

bronze.name: Angelina Extra Firm
bronze.highlight: Extra-firm hybrid support at a value price
bronze.highlight_es: Soporte híbrido extra firme a precio de valor

topPickReason.en: The value path to real extra-firm zoned support.
topPickReason.es: El camino de valor al verdadero soporte extra firme zonificado.

detail.en: The firmest feel in the bronze tier — no plush give at all.
detail.es: La sensación más firme del nivel bronce — sin nada de suavidad.

detail.en: Center-third reinforcement most value firm beds skip.
detail.es: Refuerzo del tercio central que la mayoría de las camas firmes de valor omiten.

bronze.name: Giselle Firm
bronze.highlight: Straightforward firm support at an everyday price
bronze.highlight_es: Soporte firme directo a un precio cotidiano

topPickReason.en: Dependable firm alignment at an everyday price.
topPickReason.es: Alineación firme confiable a precio cotidiano.

detail.en: Solid support without plush layers softening the surface.
detail.es: Soporte sólido sin capas suaves que ablanden la superficie.

detail.en: The affordable path to a true firm mattress.
detail.es: El camino accesible a un colchón firme verdadero.

bronze.name: Gracie Medium
bronze.highlight: Balanced medium comfort at the friendliest price
bronze.highlight_es: Confort medio equilibrado al precio más amigable

topPickReason.en: Easy balanced comfort with zoned support — the smart starter pick.
topPickReason.es: Confort equilibrado fácil con soporte zonificado — la elección inteligente para empezar.

detail.en: Classic coil bounce that's easy to move on — no stuck-in-foam feeling.
detail.es: Rebote clásico de resortes fácil para moverse — sin sensación de quedar atrapado en espuma.

detail.en: The most affordable way into a zoned Restonic build.
detail.es: La forma más accesible de entrar a una construcción Restonic zonificada.

cardPriorities.note: Verbatim output of buildMattressPriorities(m) per surviving model per language ({title, desc, tag, matched} rows). The production card template renders the first three rows; prototypes do the same by index and never re-derive or reorder them.

results.note: tierData is the verbatim projection of _resultsState.tierData: per-tier order, qualification (>=60% of tier max), cap 3 and min-2 back-fill exactly as the engine produced them. pct/score are included for provenance and parity checking only — neither may be rendered on any screen.

compareDemo.note: SIMULATED saved-finalist state for the Compare discoverability demo — save history is customer input, so savedOrder is authored (tier leads in save order) and disclosed as such. The PAIR is computed by executing the real extracted compareReviewFinalists() (index.html:17398-17409) against that state, never re-typed. Prototype interactions against this state are prototype behavior, not production.
